description: Stable package rename to the @blulotus/trellis namespace.
changelog:
**Internal:**
- chore(release): renamed the published CLI and core packages from `@mindfoldhq/trellis` / `@mindfoldhq/trellis-core` to `@blulotus/trellis` / `@blulotus/trellis-core` and promoted the 0.7 beta line to stable.
notes: Install the renamed @blulotus packages when upgrading from the previous namespace. No project-file migration is required.
